subject: Beautification Committee Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee reviewed and amended proposed draft language establishing a municipal Beautification Committee. The subcommittee voted to report the amended ordinance favorably to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Beautification Committee Ordinance (Paper 20-006)
items.summary: The subcommittee amended the ordinance to create a seven-member advisory committee subject to City Council confirmation, with non-voting staff liaisons from Public Works and Planning and a minimum of six meetings annually. Despite concerns raised by Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian regarding administrative workload and staffing constraints, the motion to report the amended draft favorably to the Committee of the Whole passed.
